contract.input: full 32-bit filter; actual callers pass 0 and 4
contract.reset: fill 400 output bytes with 0xff, yielding 200 signed-word -1 sentinels
contract.item_id: signed word; negative values skipped; quantity word never read
contract.item_type: signed word at item record byte +82 (word 41), stride 190
contract.include: item_type == filter or filter == 0 or (item_type == 3 and filter == 4)
contract.output: accepted inventory slot indices as signed words in stable prefix order
contract.return: unstable EAX ignored/overwritten by both callers
contract.owner_boundary: stack probe, fill callee, both callers, draw and selector remain independent

contract.background: context 0 world, 1 scene, 2 battle, otherwise no redraw
contract.metric: first exact -1 inventory slot plus one, else 200
contract.arrows: down iff metric > 5*(page+3); up iff metric > 15 and page > 0
contract.mapping: word_D27C0 logical list position -> signed real inventory slot
contract.selection: selected border color 255 before selected-entry validation
contract.record: 190-byte item stride; id+0 names+2/+22 description+42 role+76 selector+80 type+82
contract.name: selector chooses name; x 140 or 160 minus 4*byte_length; y 5
contract.role: nonnegative role index formats 182-byte-stride role name +8 as (%s) at 205,5
contract.quantity: signed >1 only: X at 215,5 and %2d at 235,5
contract.present: exactly once on every path after rendering
contract.return: unstable EAX ignored by all three callers
contract.boundary: arrow/background/primitive/string/present callees, reset, selector and callers remain independent

callee.status_wait: read port 0x3DA until bit 3 is set; at least one read and no timeout
callee.data_write: LODSB then write source[0..767] in ascending order to port 0x3C9
callee.return_eax: incoming EAX high 24 bits with AL replaced by source[767]

activation_order.observable_effect: when signed remainder becomes 1, the newly copied indexed frame is recolored by the immediately following DAC submission before tick wait or scene continuation

modern_boundary.canonical_domain: 256 colors in RGB order with three six-bit channel bytes per color
modern_boundary.equivalence: copy all 256 RGB6 colors by value; host present indexes the copied palette without changing indexed pixels; a due post-copy palette cycle is previewed in that host present and committed only after present succeeds
platform_adapted: VGA 0x3DA vertical-retrace polling replaced by host presentation scheduling
VGA 0x3C8/0x3C9 port writes replaced by an owned LegacyPalette snapshot
RGB6 channels expanded to RGBA8 only in the host presentation adapter
invalid channel values and host presentation failures are safely rejected
incidental EAX is replaced by void palette assignment and bool host present result

contract.submitted_pointer: same private scratch address for all 64 calls
